finding_6.reproduced: by arithmetic from the code (a 429 answer is fast, so the realistic worst case is lower than the reviewer's figure, but a slow provider can still make every attempt take its full read timeout)

before_worst_seconds.one_model_call: 3 attempts x 30 s + 3 s + 8 s waits = 101
before_worst_seconds.recipe_view: 20 per view during a YouTube outage, every view

finding_6.fix: budget = the app's 90 s wait; a model call (retries and waits included) gets (90 - 20 s YouTube timeout) / 2 = 35 s; a revision asks again only if 35 s still fit; a video search gets 90 - 2 x 20 = 50 s (over twice the slowest recorded search); each attempt may take only the time left; a failed YouTube credit lookup is not retried for the quota-derived check period (about 19 min)

after_worst_seconds.recipe_view: 20 once per check period during an outage

finding_6.limit: httpx timeouts bound the gap between bytes, not the whole transfer, so a provider that trickles bytes can still exceed an attempt's timeout
